susten-grimsel-furka-triple-crown.title: Susten · Grimsel · Furka Triple Crown
susten-grimsel-furka-triple-crown.story: Cold alpine dawn, three big passes, no wasted kilometres. A 223 km loop that starts and ends near Altdorf, about 4 h 17 of riding. The climbs: Sustenpass west, Grimselpass and Furkapass glacier road. It tops out at about 2,450 m. Susten Pass, Grimsel Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 13 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
